Database.// MigrationsPath: Directory of reviewed *.sql migration scripts applied at startup, on ANY backend. Empty/absent = disabled (the default). Scripts here should only ALTER existing tables — creating tables is CodeFirst's job in every environment. See db/migrations/README.md.
Database.// AutoSyncSchema: DEV ONLY. true = CodeFirst structurally syncs EXISTING tables against the entities, which can MODIFY and DROP columns. Ignored (with a warning) outside Development. Creating missing tables happens regardless and is not controlled by this flag. Default false — see db/migrations/README.md for when auto-sync is unsafe.

Testing.// PostgresConnection: Opt-in PG integration suite (PostgresIntegrationTests). Set in appsettings.Development.json to a DISPOSABLE database whose name contains 'test'. Empty = tests skip. Env var STRUO_TEST_PG_CONNECTION overrides.

Struo.// ContentAssemblies: Assemblies scanned for [CmsCollection] content types. Add your content project's assembly name here (usually your content project's name), e.g. [ "Acme.Content" ]. The assembly must actually be resolvable via Assembly.Load, which means it must be registered in Struo.Api.deps.json (in practice, referenced by the host, e.g. via a ProjectReference) - a DLL merely sitting next to Struo.Api.dll is not enough - or the entry fails startup rather than being skipped.

Auth.// BootstrapAdmin: Seeded ONLY when the users table is first created. Ships a default admin/admin so a fresh install always has a login. OVERRIDE in production via env Auth__BootstrapAdmin__Email / Auth__BootstrapAdmin__Password (or appsettings.Production.json). A production start still on the default password logs a WARNING.
Auth.// Password: Plaintext password rules enforced at every write path (create user, change password). MinLength is also published to the SPA via GET /api/config for inline validation and generator length. MaxLength is a sanity bound only — Argon2id cost is fixed by its own parameters, not by input length. Override via env e.g. Auth__Password__MinLength=12 (read at startup; changing it requires a restart).

RateLimiting.// Login: App-layer login rate limiter (POST /api/auth/login only). Enabled=true is secure-by-default for direct/single-instance deployments. Set Enabled=false in multi-pod deployments (e.g. Kubernetes) where per-IP rate limiting is enforced at the ingress/edge/WAF instead — this in-memory limiter is per-pod and cannot enforce a true global limit across replicas. Override via env e.g. RateLimiting__Login__Enabled=false (read at startup; changing it requires a restart).
